content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, digital creators often face significant barriers to receiving payments for their products. This challenge is particularly acute in countries such as Nigeria and Kenya, where payout delays and restrictions hinder growth. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-everything-you-need-15|setting]] up NOWPayments with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-17|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Workers offers a robust solution, enabling you to receive crypto payments seamlessly while maintaining complete ownership over your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-7|The Full]].

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often impose restrictions based on geography, leading to frustrating delays and unfulfilled transactions. In contrast, by leveraging NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you establish a decentralized infrastructure that is immune to geographic limitations. This architecture allows you to accept payments in USDT and other cryptocurrencies directly, ensuring swift transactions with minimal fees. For instance, USDT transactions on the Tron network cost under $0.10, making it an economical choice for creators looking to maximize their earnings.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To successfully deploy your payment infrastructure, you’ll need a few key components. Start by setting up a Cloudflare account to utilize their Pages and Workers. Next, create a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions without KYC requirements. You’ll also want access to a Supabase instance for order management and a domain for your online store. With these tools in place, you will be ready to build a reliable payment solution that fits your needs, free from the constraints of conventional platforms.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The next step is to integrate NOWPayments with Cloudflare Workers to create an efficient payment pipeline. Begin by configuring your Cloudflare Workers to handle incoming payment requests. Set up the necessary webhooks provided by NOWPayments to ensure that you receive transaction confirmations in real-time. This will enable you to deliver products instantly upon payment receipt. Additionally, use Supabase to store order information securely, allowing you to manage your sales effectively without relying on third-party platforms.
NOWPayments guarantees swift, low-cost transactions without the need for KYC.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set, it’s time to go live. Begin by testing your setup with a small transaction to ensure that everything functions smoothly. Monitor the webhook responses from NOWPayments to confirm that payments are being processed correctly. Once you’ve confirmed the process, promote your store through social media and online communities to drive traffic. Remember, your customers will appreciate the quick settlement times, especially compared to traditional services like PayPal, which can take days to process transactions.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, consider scaling your operations. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can easily add more products to your store and enhance your infrastructure without additional costs. Review customer feedback and data analytics to identify which products are performing best. This information will guide your marketing efforts and product development, allowing you to optimize sales and increase your revenue stream efficiently.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
Cloudflare Workers empower you to create a seamless payment experience online.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The complete payment pipeline — from buyer checkout to local currency in your account — involves three components: NOWPayments for on-chain verification, your sovereign stack backend for order processing and delivery, and a P2P exchange for conversion to local currency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the first two components under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete process including P2P conversion guidance for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Both available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Configure your payout destination before configuring your store. Your self-custody wallet address goes into NOWPayments as the destination for each coin you accept — this is where funds land when a transaction confirms on-chain. Never use an exchange wallet address as your NOWPayments destination — use a self-custody wallet where you control the private keys. Set up Binance P2P or a local exchange and verify the conversion process for your local currency pair. Deploy your stack and run a mainnet test. After the first real sale confirms, wait for the transaction to fully clear in NOWPayments, then transfer from your self-custody wallet to your exchange for conversion.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?
Set up a NOWPayments account and integrate it with Cloudflare Workers. This configuration allows you to process crypto payments directly, ensuring quick transactions and data ownership.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?
USDT transactions on the Tron network are processed almost instantly, typically within minutes, unlike PayPal, which can take several days for funds to clear.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?
Creators can utilize peer-to-peer exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin to naira. These platforms facilitate fast transactions and competitive rates for currency conversion.
What are the transaction fees with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of just 0.5% per transaction, making it a cost-effective solution compared to traditional payment processors.
Can I use Cloudflare Workers for other applications?
Yes, Cloudflare Workers can be used for various applications beyond payments, such as hosting static sites or building APIs, offering flexibility in your infrastructure.
Own your infrastructure and eliminate reliance on traditional payment platforms.
